value.rationale: A complete sharp all-timestep positivity classification for an infinite family of dense nonbipartite graph diffusion systems, with a strict stability/positivity separation for every n>=5 and a quantitatively sharp large-n ratio. The same result covers any strongly regular graph with identical intersection parameters, including nonisomorphic Chang graphs. These statements answer a meaningful graph-dependent numerical-positivity gap and are not a parameter substitution or isolated finite census.
